'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Colombian conflict]], [[Venezuelan crisis]]
**[[2021 Apure clashes]]
***Eight [[Venezuelan soldier]]s are killed in clashes with [[irregular armed group]]s operating on the [[Colombia]]n [[Colombia-Venezuela border|border]]. The [[Venezuelan government]] says that the groups are [[narcoterrorist]]s connected to [[President of Colombia|Colombian president]] [[Ivan Duque]] while [[government of Colombia|Colombian security sources]] say that they are [[FARC dissidents]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/4/29/eight-venezuelan-soldiers-killed-in-clashes-on-colombian-border (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan clashes|2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan conflict]]
**A clash between [[Tajikistan]] and [[Kyrgyzstan]] forces on [[Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan border|the border]] between the two countries results in four deaths and dozens of injuries. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/apr/29/tajikistan-and-kyrgyzstan-armies-clash-on-disputed-border (''The Guardian'')]
**The foreign ministers of [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Tajikistan|Tajikistan]] and [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Kyrgyzstan)|Kyrgyzstan]] say they have agreed to a ceasefire at the border. [https://tass.com/world/1285011 (TASS)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Cross-Strait relations]], [[Economy of Taiwan]]
**The [[Ministry of Labor (Taiwan)|Taiwanese Ministry of Labor]] bans both domestic and foreign companies from advertising jobs located in [[China]], especially ones related to the [[integrated circuit]] and [[semiconductor]] industries. The move comes in light of both increased tensions between the two countries, and China aggressively recruiting Taiwanese workers to build up its own semiconductor industry. [https://asia.nikkei.com/Business/Tech/Semiconductors/Taiwan-bans-recruitment-for-jobs-in-China-to-combat-brain-drain (''Nikkei Asia'')]
*The price of [[copper]] exceeds [[United States dollar|US$]]10,000 per tonne for the first time since February 2011. Analysts cite a strong demand in [[China]] and the weakening of the U.S. dollar for the increase in price. [https://www.channelstv.com/2021/04/29/copper-prices-hit-10000-for-first-time-in-a-decade/ (Channels TV)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]], [[Lineage B.1.617]]
****[[Nouvelle-Aquitaine]] reports [[France]]'s first case of the Lineage B.1.617 variant in a person who travelled from [[India]]. [https://medicalxpress.com/news/2021-04-case-covid-indian-variant-france.html (MedicalXpress)]
****[[President of France|President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] unveils a gradual easing of [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]]. He said schools would reopen on May 3, followed by the reopening of museums, cinemas, shops, and cafés on May 19. In the second week of June, cafés and restaurants will be allowed to serve inside and the curfew will be scrapped on June 30 after it pushes back to 9:00 p.m. [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/04/29/world/france-covid-lockdown.html (''The New York Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] surpasses four million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.ansa.it/english/news/general_news/2021/04/29/covid-14320-new-cases-288-more-victims_07c3e2fe-190b-43cb-bf0c-aeae1b776f6d.html (ANSA in English)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Romania]], [[Lineage B.1.617]]
****[[Romania]] reports its first case of the Lineage B.1.617 variant first detected in [[India]] in a person from [[Brașov County]]. [https://www.romania-insider.com/romania-indian-variant-april-2021 (Romania Insider)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong]]
****[[Hong Kong]] reopens bars and nightclubs to those who have received at least one vaccine dose. These venues will also be allowed to stay open until 2:00 a.m. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/04/28/us-health-coronavirus-hongkong (Euronews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[India]] reports a new global record of 379,257 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the total number of confirmed cases to 18.38 million. The country also reports a record 3,645 deaths in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 204,832. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/india-covid-19-infections-cross-18-million-mark-14712796 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam]] 
****[[Vietnam]] reports its first locally transmitted COVID-19 cases in 35 days, in four members of a family from [[Hà Nam Province]] and one person from [[Ho Chi Minh City]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/vietnam-reports-first-local-covid-19-cases-in-35-days (''The Straits Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
****[[Argentina]] reports a record 561 deaths in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 63,508. [https://www.perfil.com/noticias/coronavirus/covid-19-nuevo-record-muertes-diarios-561-fallecidos-26053-casos.phtml (''Perfil'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
****[[Brazil]] surpasses 400,000 [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|COVID-19 deaths]], becoming the second country to do so after the United States. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-brazil/brazil-passes-400000-covid-19-fatalities-with-high-death-toll-to-plateau-for-months-idUSKBN2CG232 (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York City]]
*****[[New York City]] [[Mayor of New York City|mayor]] [[Bill de Blasio]] announces the city government's intent to lift all [[pandemic]]-related restrictions and "fully reopen" by July 1. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/new-york-city-to-fully-reopen-on-july-1-mayor-bill-de-blasio-says/ (CBS News)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Louisiana]], [[Lineage P.1]]
*****[[Louisiana]] reports their first two cases of the Lineage P.1 variant that originated in [[Brazil]]. [https://www.nola.com/news/coronavirus/article_7f922c24-a920-11eb-bac0-c3c24590546e.html (''The Times-Picayune'')]
****The U.S. [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention]] estimates that roughly 35 percent of the country's population had been infected with COVID-19 as of March 2021. This represents about a fourfold increase from the official reported numbers. [https://www.cnn.com/world/live-news/coronavirus-pandemic-vaccine-updates-04-29-21/h_40d99e1d1aab9c3a21ec4aab66071f86 (CNN)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Costa Rica]]
****[[Costa Rica]] announces new COVID-19 restrictions on driving and businesses amidst a rise of new cases. [https://ticotimes.net/2021/04/29/costa-rica-announces-new-closures-driving-restrictions-for-early-may (''The Tico Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo]]
****The [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] announces that it will redeploy several of their [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|AstraZeneca]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccines]] to other [[Africa]] countries. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/congo-starts-re-deployment-expiring-covid-19-vaccines-other-african-countries-2021-04-29/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Uganda]], [[Lineage B.1.617]]
****[[Uganda]] reports its first cases of the Lineage B.1.617 variant in people who travelled from [[India]] to [[Kampala]]. [https://www.independent.co.ug/indian-covid-19-variant-in-kampala/ (''The Independent Uganda'')]
*[[China]] reports a new outbreak of the [[African Swine Fever]] in [[Inner Mongolia]], where 343 of 432 [[pig]]s died on a farm near [[Baotou]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/china-reports-african-swine-fever-outbreak-inner-mongolia-2021-04-29/ (Reuters)]
*The U.S. [[Food and Drug Administration]] announces that it will ban [[Flavored tobacco|flavored cigars]] and [[menthol cigarette]]s within a year, claiming they disproportionately impact low-income and minority households. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/04/29/health/fda-menthol-cigarette-ban/index.html (CNN)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Cyprus dispute]]
**[[President of Cyprus]] [[Nicos Anastasiades]] says that the [[two-state solution (Cyprus)|two-state solution]] proposed by [[Turkish Cypriots]] will never be accepted and claims that it violates [[United Nations]] resolutions. Greek Cypriots advocate a federal united country, whereas the Turkish side supports a two-state solution. [https://www.reuters.com/world/greek-cypriots-say-turkish-two-state-offer-wont-work-2021-04-29/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Papua conflict]]
**[[Indonesia]]n [[Government of Indonesia|authorities]] formally designate [[Free Papua Movement|West Papuan separatist]]s as "[[terrorism in Indonesia|terrorist]]s", after a call on Sunday from [[President of Indonesia|President]] [[Joko Widodo]] to crack down on them. The [[Coordinating Ministry for Political, Legal, and Security Affairs (Indonesia)|Chief Security Minister]] cites a 2018 [[counter-terrorism]] law to back the measure whereas a spokesperson for the West Papua National Liberation Army rejects the move. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-designates-papuan-separatists-terrorists-2021-04-29/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Congress of the Union|Mexican Congress]] passes legislation outlawing [[revenge porn]]. It is sent to [[President of Mexico|President]] [[Andrés Manuel López Obrador]] for his signature. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexico-punish-revenge-porn-with-jail-terms-up-6-years-2021-04-30/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2021 NFL season]]
**In [[American football]], the [[National Football League]] starts its [[2021 NFL Draft|draft]] for the [[2021 NFL season|2021 season]], with the [[Jacksonville Jaguars]] taking [[quarterback]] [[Trevor Lawrence (American football)|Trevor Lawrence]] as the first pick of the draft. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/nfl/draft/2021/04/29/nfl-draft-2021-live-stream-time-watch-first-round-television/7393655002/ (''USA Today'')] [https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/31361456/jacksonville-jaguars-select-former-clemson-qb-trevor-lawrence-no-1-overall-pick-nfl-draft (ESPN)]
